_fixture: SYNTHETIC-FIXTURE ProtView M17 T1 oracle. Values are hand-derived (see each 'how'); RDKit was used only to canonicalise hand-written SMILES. Cross-check results are in docs/qa/m17-ligand-20261001/preflight.txt.

no_h._how: written by hand from the atom block order chosen at generation; bond orders are the RDKit-sanitized types (ring = aromatic). Serial = 1-based SDF atom-block line, H lines included.

explicit_h._how: written by hand from the atom block order chosen at generation; bond orders are the RDKit-sanitized types (ring = aromatic). Serial = 1-based SDF atom-block line, H lines included.

block_libraries._ordinal_assumption: SMILES ordinal = 1-based count of non-skipped lines (blank and '#' lines are not records), so '*O' is record 15 on file line 18 and is named block_15. If the implementation counts file lines instead the name would be block_18; spec 3.3 says 'input ordinal', T2/T3 must fix this choice.
block_libraries._rejection_precedence_assumption: each rejected record here has exactly one applicable reason

results.how: 2 reactants, 1 product, O:1 mapped in first template
valid form; first template matches the acetyl group (outside site)
first template [O][CH3] has no atom map
exactly 4096 bytes (boundary), same form as user_1

generation_with_site_methoxy._how: site = methoxy O+CH3 (no-H serials [11,12], explicit-H [19,20]); products written by hand, string-assembled as core 'CC(=O)Nc1ccc(cc1)' + substituent, then RDKit-canonicalised.

rules_smiles_library.how: [CH3][C:1]=[O:2] matches acetyl serials 1,2,3 (no-H), all outside site

generation_with_site_methoxy.rule_not_matching: user_1/user_2/user_3/user_10 give no product with chain64, acetic_acid (except user_2) or bromoethane (except user_1/user_3); user_10 needs a 4065-carbon chain block
generation_with_site_methoxy._union_duplicates: fixed_methyl from methyl, methyl_alt, sdf_methyl (3 paths); phenacetin from sdf_rgroup_ethoxy (fixed) and user_1 x bromoethane (2 paths)
generation_with_site_methoxy.stereo_flag_all: none (no stereo element in parent or blocks)
